mechanisms.name: Authored app weave and learned cognitive weave are incompatible uses of one term
mechanisms.observed_mechanism: WeaveSpec v0.1 is dated January6 but present in the April22 and Aug5 recovered history. It defines a weave as an authored declarative app with mount/unmount lifecycle, selected laws/goals and output rendering. July/August progression instead defines a weave as integrated learned relation capability expressed through the organism body, and explicitly excludes stored answers, supplied language/TTS and scripted motor programs.
mechanisms.evidence_limits: The older app document cannot serve as a current cognition specification because it uses the same name. It may document an external historical application concept; no active mount or implementation is established by its presence. Renaming it would not repair an active conflicting controller.
mechanisms.replacement: Canonicalize cognitive terms by actual physical state and function. Retain the older application specification as dated historical context and audit all consumers before retirement or migration. Keep caretaker/app configuration external to pupil cognitive authority and resolve original decisions rather than treating the newest label as proof.

mechanisms.name: Seeded determinism and bounded output do not legalize score-driven cognition
mechanisms.observed_mechanism: WeaveSpec gives explicit seeds, lowest-id tie examples, float32/64 precision, weighted law/goal examples, det_commit0.85, p_commit0.70, cooldown gates, motif budgets and 30/60-day decay half-lives. Those are declarative design examples, not traced active execution. Stable seeds/hashes and SafeHold output limits establish neither full-field cognition nor a derived memory law.
mechanisms.evidence_limits: A deterministic algorithm can still be a forbidden heuristic. Conversely, a physical sampling rate or justified output safety bound is not automatically one. Precision language in this old application spec does not authorize changing frozen L0-L4 or truncating exact native ternary state. Current invocation and original approval remain unproved.
mechanisms.replacement: Classify each parameter by its actual role and derivation. Keep required physical/resource bounds, reject unratified score, tie, timeout and decay authority over pupil learning or expression. Do not import the old text example as an implementation shortcut for speech.
